title: Lantern Panther
style: Phonk-comedy fusion at a head-nodding mid-tempo with sneaky swung drums, rubbery sub-bass, and playful local percussion colors; verse rides beatbox clicks, handclaps, and cheeky spoken hooks; pre-chorus strips to harmonized hums and rising crowd chants; chorus hits with stacked backing singers, short English-Spanish-Chinese taglines, and call-response. Bright, punchy, mischievous mix with close-mic vocals and ad-lib swells., comedy
lyrics:
[Intro]
Shh-shh, watch me slide
喵一下，别眨眼
Hola, I’m in the lane
Beatbox under my tongue
Brrt-ka, brrt-ka, ha

[Verse 1]
I come in soft on the tile
One paw, then I smile
Old auntie sees me pass
She says, “哎呀, that kid got class”
Fish stall, red umbrella
I nod to the salsa seller
“Qué tal?” I steal the lime
Then vanish clean on time

[Pre-Chorus]
Mm-hmm, hear that hum
All the voices rise as one
Low bass, high grin
Let the little chaos in
Aye, aye, shh
You know what this is

[Chorus]
Lantern Panther, move
Lantern Panther, groove
喵喵，太会了
Mira, mira, slow then loose
Lantern Panther, slide
Lantern Panther, hide
We sing, we clap, we bounce
Then I’m gone in one cool stride

[Verse 2]
At the noodle shop, I bow
老板笑着问我 now
“吃了吗?” I say “sí”
With a drum on my knee
Kids shout, “再来一次!”
I trade them a wink and a twist
I keep it fresh, keep it clean
Like a prank in a movie scene

[Pre-Chorus]
Mm-hmm, hear that hum
All the voices rise as one
Low bass, high grin
Let the little chaos in
Aye, aye, shh
You know what this is

[Chorus]
Lantern Panther, move
Lantern Panther, groove
喵喵，太会了
Mira, mira, slow then loose
Lantern Panther, slide
Lantern Panther, hide
We sing, we clap, we bounce
Then I’m gone in one cool stride

[Bridge]
[Beatbox break]
Pff-ka, pff-ka, tsk-tsk
Harmonic voice on the drip
Sing it soft, then lift
Three tongues on the tip
喔—哦—ay
We laugh, we sway

[Final Chorus]
Lantern Panther, move
Lantern Panther, groove
喵喵，太会了
Mira, mira, slow then loose
Lantern Panther, slide
Lantern Panther, hide
All the singers fall in line
And the whole block rides tonight
